name: week
title: Recall work this week
subtitle: Fictional demo records until replaced with your data

sections.title: Campaigns
sections.sql: select code,owner,affected,complete,active,imported,overdue,report_due from campaign_summary order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select campaign,vin,coordinator,dealer,due_on,reason from attention_queue order by due_on,vin,reason

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: select campaign,vin,dealer,state,appointment_on from case_work where state<>'complete' order by dealer nulls first,vin

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_checks order by record,rule

sections.title: Remedies waiting for verification
sections.sql: select w.campaign,w.vin,m.performed_on,m.recorded_by,m.evidence_ref from remedies m join case_work w on w.id=m.case_id where m.decision='pending' order by w.campaign,w.vin
